title: Telecommunications ontology
description: Portable telecommunications semantics imported from the supplied Lattice ontology.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Ontology
metadata:
  name: telco
  title: Telecommunications Ontology
  description: Fundamental entities and relationships shared across Telecommunications decision contracts.
  version: 0.1.0
  source:
    system: lattice
    sourceId: telco-ontology
    sourceVersion: 0.1.0
    sourceDigest: sha256:663b7242d268d9589d57781355f7925db84c026cfa516308e91bf72a0a963938
spec:
  types:
    - id: subscriber
      label: Subscriber
      description: A customer with one or more service subscriptions.
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/0
      properties:
        - id: subscriber.subscriber_id
          label: Subscriber Id
          description: Stable subscriber identifier.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/0/properties/0
        - id: subscriber.account_number
          label: Account Number
          description: Billing account number.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/0/properties/1
        - id: subscriber.subscriber_type
          label: Subscriber Type
          description: Residential, business, wholesale, or IoT.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/0/properties/2
        - id: subscriber.status
          label: Status
          description: Active, suspended, cancelled, ported.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/0/properties/3
        - id: subscriber.signup_date
          label: Signup Date
          description: Date subscription was created.
          dataType: date
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/0/properties/4
    - id: service
      label: Service
      description: A governed product offering such as mobile, broadband, voice, or enterprise circuit.
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/1
      properties:
        - id: service.service_id
          label: Service Id
          description: Stable service instance identifier.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/1/properties/0
        - id: service.service_type
          label: Service Type
          description: Mobile, broadband, voice, IPTV, enterprise, IoT.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/1/properties/1
        - id: service.plan_name
          label: Plan Name
          description: Name of the active service plan.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/1/properties/2
        - id: service.activation_date
          label: Activation Date
          description: Date service was activated.
          dataType: date
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/1/properties/3
        - id: service.status
          label: Status
          description: Pending, active, suspended, disconnected.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/1/properties/4
        - id: service.msisdn
          label: MSISDN
          description: Mobile station international subscriber directory number.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/1/properties/5
        - id: service.ip_address
          label: IP Address
          description: Assigned IP address.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/1/properties/6
    - id: network_element
      label: Network Element
      description: A physical or logical element of the telco network such as BTS, eNodeB, OLT, or core node.
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/2
      properties:
        - id: network_element.element_id
          label: Network Element Id
          description: Stable identifier of the network element.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/2/properties/0
        - id: network_element.element_type
          label: Network Element Type
          description: eNodeB, gNodeB, OLT, DSLAM, core router, etc.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/2/properties/1
        - id: network_element.vendor
          label: Vendor
          description: Equipment vendor such as Ericsson, Nokia, Cisco.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/2/properties/2
        - id: network_element.operational_status
          label: Operational Status
          description: In service, out of service, degraded, under maintenance.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/2/properties/3
        - id: network_element.software_version
          label: Software Version
          description: Software release running on the element.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/2/properties/4
    - id: usage_record
      label: Usage Record
      description: A measured usage event such as a call, data session, or SMS.
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/3
      properties:
        - id: usage_record.usage_id
          label: Usage Id
          description: Stable identifier of the usage event.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/3/properties/0
        - id: usage_record.usage_type
          label: Usage Type
          description: Voice, SMS, data, roaming, premium.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/3/properties/1
        - id: usage_record.started_at
          label: Started At
          description: Usage start timestamp.
          dataType: datetime
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/3/properties/2
        - id: usage_record.duration_seconds
          label: Duration Seconds
          description: Duration in seconds.
          dataType: integer
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/3/properties/3
        - id: usage_record.volume_bytes
          label: Volume Bytes
          description: Data volume in bytes.
          dataType: integer
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/3/properties/4
        - id: usage_record.rated_amount
          label: Rated Amount
          description: Rated monetary amount.
          dataType: decimal
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/3/properties/5
        - id: usage_record.currency
          label: Currency
          description: Currency code.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/3/properties/6
    - id: network_incident
      label: Network Incident
      description: An outage, degradation, or fault on the network.
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/4
      properties:
        - id: network_incident.incident_id
          label: Incident Id
          description: Stable incident identifier.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/4/properties/0
        - id: network_incident.severity
          label: Severity
          description: Severity such as P1, P2, P3, P4.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/4/properties/1
        - id: network_incident.started_at
          label: Started At
          description: Time the incident began.
          dataType: datetime
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/4/properties/2
        - id: network_incident.resolved_at
          label: Resolved At
          description: Time the incident was resolved.
          dataType: datetime
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/4/properties/3
        - id: network_incident.root_cause
          label: Root Cause
          description: Identified root cause category.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/4/properties/4
        - id: network_incident.subscribers_affected
          label: Subscribers Affected
          description: Estimated number of impacted subscribers.
          dataType: integer
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/4/properties/5
    - id: billing_invoice
      label: Billing Invoice
      description: A billing document issued to a subscriber for a billing cycle.
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/5
      properties:
        - id: billing_invoice.invoice_id
          label: Invoice Id
          description: Stable invoice identifier.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/5/properties/0
        - id: billing_invoice.billing_cycle
          label: Billing Cycle
          description: Billing cycle identifier or period.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/5/properties/1
        - id: billing_invoice.invoice_date
          label: Invoice Date
          description: Date of invoice issuance.
          dataType: date
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/5/properties/2
        - id: billing_invoice.total_amount
          label: Total Amount
          description: Total amount due.
          dataType: decimal
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/5/properties/3
        - id: billing_invoice.currency
          label: Currency
          description: Currency code.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/5/properties/4
        - id: billing_invoice.payment_status
          label: Payment Status
          description: Paid, unpaid, overdue, partial.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/5/properties/5
    # Shared core types
    - id: person
      label: Person
      description: A human being identified in a governed business context.
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/6
      properties:
        - id: person.person_id
          label: Person identifier
          description: Stable governed identifier for the person.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/6/properties/0
        - id: person.display_name
          label: Display name
          description: Preferred name used in governed interfaces.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/6/properties/1
        - id: person.effective_from
          label: Effective from
          description: Time from which this person record is valid.
          dataType: datetime
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/6/properties/2
    - id: organization
      label: Organization
      description: A governed legal, public, or operating organization.
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/7
      properties:
        - id: organization.organization_id
          label: Organization identifier
          description: Stable governed identifier for the organization.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/7/properties/0
        - id: organization.legal_name
          label: Legal name
          description: Registered or otherwise authoritative organization name.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/7/properties/1
        - id: organization.organization_type
          label: Organization type
          description: Governed classification of the organization.
          dataType: string
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/7/properties/2
    - id: agent
      label: Agent
      description: A human or software actor authorized to perform governed activity.
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/8
      properties:
        - id: agent.agent_id
          label: Agent identifier
          description: Stable governed identifier for the actor.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/8/properties/0
        - id: agent.agent_type
          label: Agent type
          description: Whether the actor is human, service, or automated.
          dataType: string
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/8/properties/1
        - id: agent.active
          label: Active
          description: Whether the agent is currently authorized.
          dataType: boolean
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/8/properties/2
    - id: location
      label: Location
      description: A physical, administrative, or virtual place relevant to governed activity.
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/9
      properties:
        - id: location.location_id
          label: Location identifier
          description: Stable governed identifier for the location.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/9/properties/0
        - id: location.name
          label: Location name
          description: Human-readable location name.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/9/properties/1
        - id: location.country_code
          label: Country code
          description: ISO country code when applicable.
          dataType: string
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/9/properties/2
    - id: document
      label: Document
      description: A governed information artifact with identity, version, and provenance.
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/10
      properties:
        - id: document.document_id
          label: Document identifier
          description: Stable governed identifier for the document.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/10/properties/0
        - id: document.title
          label: Title
          description: Authoritative document title.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/10/properties/1
        - id: document.version
          label: Version
          description: Document version or revision.
          dataType: string
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/10/properties/2
        - id: document.issued_at
          label: Issued at
          description: Time at which the document was issued.
          dataType: datetime
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/10/properties/3
    - id: event
      label: Event
      description: A governed occurrence bounded by time and business meaning.
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/11
      properties:
        - id: event.event_id
          label: Event identifier
          description: Stable governed identifier for the event.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/11/properties/0
        - id: event.event_type
          label: Event type
          description: Governed classification of the event.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/11/properties/1
        - id: event.occurred_at
          label: Occurred at
          description: Time at which the event occurred.
          dataType: datetime
          required: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/11/properties/2
    - id: asset
      label: Asset
      description: A governed physical, digital, or financial resource.
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/12
      properties:
        - id: asset.asset_id
          label: Asset identifier
          description: Stable governed identifier for the asset.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/12/properties/0
        - id: asset.name
          label: Asset name
          description: Human-readable asset name.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/12/properties/1
        - id: asset.asset_type
          label: Asset type
          description: Governed classification of the asset.
          dataType: string
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/12/properties/2
    - id: policy
      label: Policy
      description: A versioned rule or standard governing decisions and actions.
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/13
      properties:
        - id: policy.policy_id
          label: Policy identifier
          description: Stable governed identifier for the policy.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/13/properties/0
        - id: policy.title
          label: Policy title
          description: Authoritative policy title.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/13/properties/1
        - id: policy.version
          label: Version
          description: Approved policy version.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/13/properties/2
        - id: policy.effective_from
          label: Effective from
          description: Time from which the policy applies.
          dataType: datetime
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/13/properties/3
  relationships:
    - id: subscriber_owns_service
      label: OWNS_SERVICE
      description: Subscriber owns a service instance.
      sourceTypeId: subscriber
      targetTypeId: service
      cardinality: many-to-many
      sourcePath: /ontology/relationshipTypes/0
    - id: service_consumes_usage
      label: CONSUMES_USAGE
      description: Service is the subject of a usage record.
      sourceTypeId: usage_record
      targetTypeId: service
      cardinality: many-to-one
      sourcePath: /ontology/relationshipTypes/1
    - id: network_incident_affects_element
      label: AFFECTS_ELEMENT
      description: Incident references an impacted network element.
      sourceTypeId: network_incident
      targetTypeId: network_element
      cardinality: many-to-many
      sourcePath: /ontology/relationshipTypes/2
    - id: service_depends_on_element
      label: DEPENDS_ON_ELEMENT
      description: Service depends on one or more network elements.
      sourceTypeId: service
      targetTypeId: network_element
      cardinality: many-to-many
      sourcePath: /ontology/relationshipTypes/3
    - id: invoice_billed_to_subscriber
      label: BILLED_TO
      description: Invoice is billed to a subscriber.
      sourceTypeId: billing_invoice
      targetTypeId: subscriber
      cardinality: many-to-one
      sourcePath: /ontology/relationshipTypes/4
    - id: invoice_covers_service
      label: COVERS_SERVICE
      description: Invoice covers a service.
      sourceTypeId: billing_invoice
      targetTypeId: service
      cardinality: many-to-many
      sourcePath: /ontology/relationshipTypes/5
    - id: member_of
      label: MEMBER_OF
      description: A person is affiliated with an organization.
      sourceTypeId: person
      targetTypeId: organization
      cardinality: many-to-many
      sourcePath: /ontology/relationshipTypes/6
    - id: acts_for
      label: ACTS_FOR
      description: An agent acts on behalf of an organization.
      sourceTypeId: agent
      targetTypeId: organization
      cardinality: many-to-one
      sourcePath: /ontology/relationshipTypes/7
    - id: located_at
      label: LOCATED_AT
      description: An organization operates at a location.
      sourceTypeId: organization
      targetTypeId: location
      cardinality: many-to-many
      sourcePath: /ontology/relationshipTypes/8
    - id: documents
      label: DOCUMENTS
      description: A document records or describes an event.
      sourceTypeId: document
      targetTypeId: event
      cardinality: many-to-many
      sourcePath: /ontology/relationshipTypes/9
    - id: involves_asset
      label: INVOLVES_ASSET
      description: An event involves a governed asset.
      sourceTypeId: event
      targetTypeId: asset
      cardinality: many-to-many
      sourcePath: /ontology/relationshipTypes/10
    - id: governed_by_policy
      label: GOVERNED_BY_POLICY
      description: An event is governed by an applicable policy.
      sourceTypeId: event
      targetTypeId: policy
      cardinality: many-to-many
      sourcePath: /ontology/relationshipTypes/11
    - id: owned_by_organization
      label: OWNED_BY_ORGANIZATION
      description: An asset is owned or stewarded by an organization.
      sourceTypeId: asset
      targetTypeId: organization
      cardinality: many-to-one
      sourcePath: /ontology/relationshipTypes/12
